title: bomify plugin SignResult
description: The single JSON object a bomify-plugin-<kind> binary must print to stdout on success for its "signature sign" subcommand, per plugins/SIGNING-CONTRACT.md. Validate a plugin's actual stdout output (one line, one object) against this schema to check it for structural conformance.

artifactType.description: The artifact type of the referrer manifest bomify pushes to carry the envelope — ideally the signing ecosystem's own standard type (e.g. "application/vnd.dev.sigstore.bundle.v0.3+json"). Must also be listed by "signature supported-types".

mediaType.description: The media type of the envelope blob itself, passed back to "signature verify" as --media-type.

envelope.description: The signature envelope, standard base64-encoded. bomify stores the decoded bytes verbatim and hands exactly those bytes back to "signature verify".

annotations.description: Optional extra annotations for the referrer manifest.
